Transform your daily shower into a luxury experience with the Lumi+, an electric shower that pushes the boundaries of modern design and innovation. The red, grey and black coloured silicone material ensures a sleek and unobtrusive finish, making them an excellent choice for modern and traditional roofs alike.

Easy to install and highly flexible, Chimsoc High Temperature Pipe Flashings offer excellent resistance to UV, ozone, and weathering, making them a reliable and cost effective solution for your roofing needs.

Silicone rubber has a MUCH higher temperature resistance then EPDM rubber. Our silicone pipe flashings can be used from -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently. It is recommended to use silicone pipe flashings for wood burning and multi fuel stove installations.

NOW IN BLACK AND GREY COLOURS
Traditionally high temperature silicone pipe flashings have been red in colour. We offer red, and uniquely also give the option of black and grey colours.

product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. Available with your choice of Red or Green Thermometer which shows you the ideal temperature to burn your logs. This pack includes a Green Magnetic Thermometer.  The thermometer monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.  Use the handy Valiant Moisture meter to ensure you get the best burn from your fuel. Our newest model not only has a backlight screen to illuminate the reading but the built-in colour change technology indicates the moisture level of the firewood. It’s an essential tool for any fireplace owner!  Fuel quality is the single most important aspect of making a successful fire. To burn effectively the moisture content of firewood needs to be less than 20%, whether it’s being used in an open fire or a stove. Freshly felled timber can have a moisture content of between 30% and 60%, which when burnt can cause dangerous creosote build-up in chimneys. Using a moisture meter is a great way to check whether your wood will give you a safe and efficient burn, or if it needs further seasoning. The screen will glow green if your fuel contains less than 20% moisture, indicating that it’s ready to go. The new Valiant moisture meter can also be used in timber, floors and buildings in order to detect and measure moisture content.

product.name: Valiant Remora Magnetic Flue Pipe Fan, Moisture Meter and Magnetic Thermometer
product.description: The Remora is a powerful warm air circulating stove fan that features a strong magnetic clamp to attach to your flue pipe as opposed to sitting on your stove top. This means you can use it with any type of stove, regardless of the shape, size, or temperature of the top surface. It also means you can avoid the risk of damaging your stove fan by placing it too close to the fire. The fan is perfect for stoves that have a cool top, such as gas stoves, pellet stoves, or electric stoves. It can also work with stoves that have an irregular surface, such as cast-iron stoves, or a soapstone or angled top, such as Scandinavian stoves. The magnetic clamp allows you to adjust the position and angle of the fan to suit your flue pipe and optimize the airflow. The Magnetic Stove Thermometer in this pack monitors your stove temperature to optimise performance and protects your stove from overheating. It also clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption. Place the Thermometer on the top, front, or side of a flat or curved surface. The built-in magnet will maintain its hold on steel up to temperatures of around 800°F (425°C). The optimum position is on the flue collar, or if not practical, as close to the collar as possible for a stable reliable place for monitoring the stove and flue gas temperature. This thermometer is suitable for use with most vitreous enamel, iron or steel flue pipes. For stainless steel flue applications do not attempt to fix to flue pipe, attach to the stove collar or place on the stove top.

product.name: Valiant Magnetic Flue Pipe Stove Fan and Thermometer
product.description:
Ideal for Inset Stoves or Stoves with limited clearance, our Remora Stove Fan attaches to your Flue Pipe using the powerful magnetic clamp. It then disperses heat throughout your room ensuring all areas are warm in no time. 

Featuring a powerful magnetic clamp that can withstand temperatures over 400°c, the Remora can quickly and easily attach to almost any Flue Pipe (4-7”) with magnetic attraction.* Once in place, the Stove Fan will automatically kick in as soon as your Flue Pipe warms up. With a starting temperature as low as 50°C, the Remora will soon be distributing warm air silently and effortlessly throughout any living space in which it is situated.

*A very small number of Flue Pipes are made from Stainless Steel and as such will not support the magnetic clamp. Please check your flue pipe attracts magnets prior to ordering the Remora. A simple fridge magnet will identify whether or not your Flue Pipe is sufficiently magnetic.

The set also includes a magnetic thermometer which will help protect your stove from overheating.

The magnetic Thermometer clearly displays the temperature of your stove, enabling you to maintain a safe and efficient operating temperature and reduce fuel consumption.

The robust design and strong magnet of the Stove Thermometer means that it’s suitable for use on any hot steel or iron surface, including stoves, BBQ, range cookers, patio heaters, flue pipes or chimeneas.

product.name: outlet kit for ibc tanks with a s60x6 coarse thread outlet to a 25mm mdpe tee fitting
product.description:
An Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) tank is a large, reusable container designed for the efficient storage and transport of bulk liquids and granulated substances. Made from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and supported by a metal cage, these tanks are known for their strength, durability, and stability. Typically available in 1,000-liter (275-gallon) capacity, IBC tanks are widely used in various industries, including agriculture, manufacturing, and food processing, due to their versatile design and ease of handling.

Rephrased Outlet Tap Kit Description:
This outlet tap kit is designed for use with an IBC tank that features a 2" coarse threaded outlet (S60x6). The kit includes a cap that screws onto the tank, providing a secure base for attaching the nickel-plated brass full flow lever valve. To ensure a leak-proof connection, a small amount of PTFE tape is required to seal the thread. The tape also allows you to position the lever tap in an upright position. Once the tap is securely attached, you can then screw in the 25mm MDPE tee fitting, which is compatible with 25mm MDPE water supply pipes. This kit is engineered for ease of use and durability, ensuring long-lasting performance.

The monitor support clamp allows is detachable and collapsible. It can also be easily adjusted to adapt to various working angles.

A Micro SD card up to 32Gb will be required in order to record videos and images.

The system includes a 30m fibreglass push rod reel mounted cable with a diameter of 5.3mm.

product.name: Water Butt Diverter Kit Downpipe Waterbutt Filler Kit Fits Both Round & Square Downpipes - Connect Downpipe to Water Butt
product.description:
Rainwater Butt Diverter Set for waterbutts
Diverters are additional fittings that can be attached to your home downpipe to provide a direct connection to your water butt.

Designed to collect some rainwater diverting the rainwater into your waterbutt. The diverter connector kit uses a tube straight into your water butt with the ability to control any overflow when your water butt is full.

Waterbutt Connector Fixing Kit: Allows easy collection of rainwater from your downpipe. Prevents the water butt from over filling when it is full. Connects downpipe to the rain barrel.

Perfect for your garden or allotment allowing water to be easily accessed when needed.

This waterbutt hose kit set includes; 1x rain diverter, 1x hose connector, 1x flexible hose pipe, 1x washer and 1x fixing nut.

Divert rain from your downpipe to your rain barrel fits the majority of downpipes used in the home, including square and round types. Once the water butt is full (if properly fitted) the water butt will not overflow but the water will continue to flow down the downpipe.

FEATURES
Downpipe Rainwater Diversion Kit.
Suitable for both round and square downpipes
Made of sturdy black plastic
Easy to install
Great water saver
Made in the UK

Using a rainwater diverter is a great way to save on costs and time on refilling, reduce your impact on the environment and maintain a supply of free and readily available water for use around the home and garden.

PERFECT FOR FITTING A WATERBUTT TO:
Small garages, Greenhouses / Garden buildings, Sheds & Summerhouses and will fit either 68mm square or 65mm round PVC Downpipe Rainwater Pipes

product.name: Garland Budget Propagator with Drainage Holes - Small, 23cm Seed Tray for Windowsills
product.description:
Get your seeds off to a strong start with the Garland Small Budget Propagator, a practical and affordable solution for home seed germination. Designed to create a warm and sheltered environment, this compact propagator helps encourage faster germination and healthier early growth for flowers, herbs, vegetables and other young plants.

The sturdy injection-moulded base tray is made from 100% recycled plastic and features two-tier drainage holes that support effective base watering while helping to prevent waterlogging. Maintaining the correct moisture level is essential for successful germination, and the drainage system helps protect delicate seedlings from excess water during their early stages of growth.

A lightweight clear vacuum-formed lid helps retain warmth and humidity around your seeds, creating a consistent environment that encourages quicker germination and stronger development. The transparent cover also allows plenty of natural light to reach your seedlings while making it easy to monitor progress without disturbing the growing conditions.

Manufactured in the UK, this compact propagator is ideal for windowsills, conservatories, greenhouses and other small growing spaces. Measuring 23cm long, 17cm wide and 12.5cm high, it is perfectly sized for raising a variety of seedlings while taking up minimal space.

Whether you are starting a vegetable garden, growing herbs indoors or raising bedding plants for the season ahead, the Garland Small Budget Propagator offers a simple, reliable and environmentally conscious way to achieve better germination results.

product.description:
Product Specification
Product Name: 567 Pipe Sealant
Product Type: Thread Sealant
Packaging: Tube
Volume: 250ml

Description:
567 Pipe Sealant is a high-performance anaerobic thread sealant for sealing metal threaded pipe joints. It cures in the absence of air to create a durable, pressure-resistant seal that prevents leaks caused by vibration, thermal expansion and pressure changes. Suitable for plumbing, gas, water, air and industrial pipework applications. This product matches the specifications of Loctite 567 and is a direct replacement.

Irrigation pipes are primarily used for distributing water to crops, plants, and landscaping areas in agricultural fields, gardens, nurseries, and other green spaces. These pipes are crucial components of irrigation systems, facilitating the efficient and controlled delivery of water to plants.

Irrigation pipe is great for water conservation as they allow for precise water delivery directly to the root zone of plants, minimizing water wastage due to evaporation, runoff, or overspray. This precise watering helps conserve water resources. Furthermore, the controlled and uniform water distribution ensures that plants receive the optimal amount of water they need for healthy growth. Irrigation pipes are primarily used for distributing water to crops, plants, and landscaping areas in agricultural fields, gardens, nurseries, and other green spaces. These pipes are crucial components of irrigation systems, facilitating the efficient and controlled delivery of water to plants.

Irrigation pipe is great for water conservation as they allow for precise water delivery directly to the root zone of plants, minimizing water wastage due to evaporation, runoff, or overspray. This precise watering helps conserve water resources. Furthermore, the controlled and uniform water distribution ensures that plants receive the optimal amount of water they need for healthy growth. This leads to improved crop yields, better plant health, and reduced labour and water costs.

Crafted from UV-resistant materials, this irrigation pipe is built to withstand the harshest weather conditions, ensuring longevity and reliability. Its black coil design not only adds to its durability but also prevents algae growth, maintaining optimal water quality for your plants.

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens Doors or Panels, Fits 4, 5 or 6mm Glass, Seals Gaps Up to 20mm, 2000mm Length, SEAL012
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible fin which will seal any gap from 15mm to 20mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.description: Our Silicone Radiator Hoses are designed to deliver dependable performance in high-temperature and high-pressure environments. Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. Operating in temperatures from -50°C to +220°C (with peaks up to +250°C), they’re ideal for coolant and heating systems. Available in diameters from 13mm up to 152mm and supplied in 1-metre lengths, each hose provides a smooth internal bore for optimal flow and easy fitment. With wall thicknesses of 4.5mm or 5.5mm depending on size, they offer working pressures up to 8.3 Bar and burst ratings up to 27 Bar. Whether you're upgrading a cooling system, managing engine bay airflow, or replacing worn components, these hoses combine flexibility, durability, and reliability in one robust package.

product.name: Nissan Primastar (2022+) Opening Passenger Side Window, and Fitting Kit, Privacy
product.description:
Upgrade your vehicle with our precision engineered Van Windows - built for perfect fitment, lasting quality and everyday reliability. Manufactured to ISO 9001, CE and TUV standards, each window meets strict European safety requirements and is tailored to the exact contours of your van for a clean, factory quality finish. Ideal for camper conversions, trade use or replacing existing panels, these windows combine performance, durability and professional style.

Made from high strength tempered glass, each window is designed for maximum safety and clarity. In the event of impact, the glass shatters into small blunt fragments rather than sharp shards, reducing the risk of injury. The tint is integrated during manufacturing, not applied as a film, allowing around 30 percent light transmission to create privacy and reduce glare. Unlike surface coatings, the built in tint will not fade, bubble or peel, keeping your van looking smart for years to come.

Opening window options feature a smooth sliding mechanism on an internal rail with a secure latch that automatically locks when closed. An integrated drainage channel directs water safely outside, keeping your interior dry and protected in all weather. Fixed window versions offer the same precision fit and premium finish for a seamless, professional appearance.

Every Van Window is delivered in custom packaging with heavy duty protective inserts to ensure it arrives safely. Available individually or as a full set, and with optional fitting kits, they make installation straightforward and reliable. Combining exact fitment, premium materials and safety tested construction, our Van Windows provide the perfect balance of style, security and practicality for any van upgrade.

product.name: ProWarm 100W Premium Electric Underfloor Heating Mat (for Tile/Stone/Laminate/Wood) - 3.5m²
product.description:
Take the chill off tile, stone, laminate and engineered wood floors with ProWarm electrical underfloor heating. Designed for bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces, the pre-spaced mesh mat provides discreet, even warmth and can supplement or replace radiators when sized for room heat loss. Insulation and thermostat control help direct heat upwards and limit wasted energy. Roll out the mat, cut the mesh only to turn it, then spread flexible tile adhesive or pour self-levelling compound over the cable. Never cut the heating cable or fit it beneath fixed furniture. A 4 metre cold tail aids routing. A qualified electrician must connect the system. The cable has a lifetime manufacturer's warranty.

Choose from three wattages: 
100W for new-builds or secondary heating in older homes.
150W for primary heating in bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.
200W for faster warm-up times and high heat loss areas.

product.description:
Heavy Duty Manhole Lifting Pin

Here at SecureFix Direct we currently have in stock a huge selection of lifting equipment and other tools including Web Slings, Shackles and Lifting Clutches, the latest addition to our impressive range are these Manhole Lifting Pins.

Our Man Hole Ring Lifting Pins and designed to allow pre-cast concrete rings and manhole chambers to be lifted, installed and positioned quickly, easily and most importantly safely. Stated Safe Working Load is when the pins are used in pairs.

Lightweight but exceptionally strong, the tray includes a pre-formed 2% gradient for efficient drainage and is coated with a cementitious layer, ready for tiling with ceramic, porcelain, stone, or mosaics.  Available in both 20mm and 25mm depths, this versatile tray can be trimmed by up to 50mm from each edge (equal cuts required), giving installers complete flexibility. It comes with a Corner-positioned square drain, with a choice of three grate designs – Leaf, Tile, or Square – and three finishes: Black, Gold, or Stainless Steel. product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Black - 250mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner and outer layer and reinforced with 3 or 4 plies of polyester braid, these couplers deliver exceptional strength, flexibility, and reliability. Available in internal diameters from 6 mm up to 152 mm and lengths from 50 mm to 950 mm, they cover everything from compact engine bays to large industrial installations. Built to SAEJ20 industry standards and compatible with most fluids, these couplers are trusted by professionals for motorsport, marine, automotive, and manufacturing use. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: Hoses UK 45mm Black PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 5m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Black PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a high-quality, flexible hose designed for connecting water butts, downpipes, and ponds. Its solid black wall helps prevent algae growth in outdoor systems, making it an ideal choice for rainwater harvesting and pond circulation applications. Made from smooth PVC inner layer with UV-resistant corrugated PVC outer wall, this hose features high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it suitable for a wide range of light to medium-duty environments. Operating within the temperature range of -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C), this hose is compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001 standards and offers reliable performance across repeated use. The hose can be cut to length, fitted with hose clips (sold separately), and features a working pressure range of 3 to 5 bar with a burst factor of three times the rating. Its transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, making it particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. Typical applications include pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, light industrial fluid handling tasks, workshop water transfer, and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential.

Antibacterial and non-slip swimming pool and sauna runner
When designing the environment in publicly accessible wet areas two factors should never be neglected: Safety and hygiene. Wherever moisture is carried around and comes into contact with the floor, there is a risk of slip accidents and the development and spread of germs. The solution: the anti-slip hygiene mats "Anti-Slip".
Anti-slip mat for wet areas - can be used indoors and outdoors
Thanks to the antibacterial coating, these hygiene mats, which are available in customised sizes, counteract the growth and spread of bacteria and fungi. The extremely non-slip and open wave structure of the antibacterial runners ensures that water and other liquids can flow off unhindered. For this reason, the hygiene mat is not only suitable for use in swimming pools or saunas, but also in showers and changing rooms where the safety of visitors must be ensured. The flame-retardant wet-room mat can also be used outdoors due to its UV and temperature resistance (-5° C to 60° C).
Cleaning and care are uncomplicated. All that is needed is water and a cleaning agent. The open structure allows the anti-slip mat to dry quickly afterwards.

The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. product.name: 19mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Euro Cylinder - Nickel, 35/35 (70mm), 3 Extra (6 total)
product.description: High security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ euro cylinder combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ is Secured by Design accredited and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacksvia several defensive mechanisms: A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. The attacker will also fail to grab the drive bar, due to the bars tapered anti-grip ends. Leaving no way of manipulating or removing the cam. An innovative anti-tilt mechanism prevents the cam section from lowering when the cylinder is snapped, reducing further the space an attacker has to manipulate the mechanism. Following a snap attack, Kinetica+ leaves the lock protected on the outside, and operational on the inside. IMPORTANT SIZE INFORMATION: Kinetica+ cylinder size is represented with the external measurement first, and internal measurement second. Size should be measured from face of cylinder to centre of screw hole. If your cylinder measures 35mm from outside face to centre of screw hole, and 45mm from centre of screw hole to inside face (80mm overall), then you should order a 35/45 (80mm) cylinder.

product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 180 Degree Silicone Elbow Hose Red - 40mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: This high-performance 180-degree silicone elbow is expertly engineered for demanding applications requiring tight-radius bends and reliable flow. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner layer and reinforced with multiple polyester braids, the SSE180 offers exceptional flexibility and resilience in high-temperature environments from -50°C to +250°C. Compliant with SAEJ20R3 standards, it’s suitable for coolant, air, and water connections in automotive, industrial, and marine systems. The outer layer is made from durable silicone to ensure longevity and resistance to ozone, UV, and chemicals. Each elbow is constructed with 3 or 4 plies of reinforcement, depending on diameter, for optimal pressure performance. Wall thickness remains consistent at 4.5–5.5mm across sizes, supporting working pressures from 2.8 to 12.33 Bar and burst pressures up to 37 Bar. The 100mm leg length and tight bend radius make it perfect for compact installations. Available in a wide range of diameters (6.5mm–102mm), this elbow is ideal for both performance upgrades and OEM replacements where precision and quality are critical.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses 1m Straight Reinforced Hose Red - 68mm High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator
product.description: Our Silicone Radiator Hoses are designed to deliver dependable performance in high-temperature and high-pressure environments. Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. Operating in temperatures from -50°C to +220°C (with peaks up to +250°C), they’re ideal for coolant and heating systems. Available in diameters from 13mm up to 152mm and supplied in 1-metre lengths, each hose provides a smooth internal bore for optimal flow and easy fitment. With wall thicknesses of 4.5mm or 5.5mm depending on size, they offer working pressures up to 8.3 Bar and burst ratings up to 27 Bar. Whether you're upgrading a cooling system, managing engine bay airflow, or replacing worn components, these hoses combine flexibility, durability, and reliability in one robust package.

product.name: 30mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

The Hudson Reed Juno 600mm Coastal Grey Wall Hung Single Drawer Vanity Unit with 1 Tap Hole Basin offers a practical wash and storage solution for modern bathrooms. Finished in matt coastal grey, the durable MFC cabinet features a soft-close drawer for organising toiletries and essentials. Measuring 600mm wide, 399mm high, and 390mm deep, the wall-hung design keeps floor space clear. Supplied with a rectangular vitreous china basin with a tap hole and integrated overflow.
Key Features
1.	Wall Hung Design: Wall mounted installation keeps the floor area clear, helping create a more open bathroom layout while making cleaning and maintenance easier.
2.	Soft-Close Drawer: Single drawer features soft-close metal runners designed to reduce everyday noise and minimise wear from regular opening and closing.
3.	Mid-Edge Basin: Rectangular vitreous china basin features a mid-edge profile with a single tap hole and integrated overflow for a practical washing area.
4.	Compact Storage: 600mm wide cabinet provides useful drawer storage for toiletries and daily essentials while maintaining a streamlined footprint.
5.	Rigid Construction: Manufactured from smooth matt MFC using cam and wood dowel assembly to form a rigid cabinet structure designed for everyday bathroom use.
Its single drawer layout provides convenient storage while maintaining a clean and streamlined appearance suited to modern bathrooms. The wall hung installation helps maximise available space and keeps the floor area visible, which can make bathrooms feel more open and easier to maintain. The soft-close drawer helps reduce everyday noise and wear during use. Supplied with a rectangular vitreous china mid-edge basin featuring a single tap hole and integrated overflow, the unit offers a practical wash space. Finished in coastal grey with rigid cabinet construction, it integrates easily into contemporary UK bathroom interiors.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend - 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° swivel bends create a tight-radius 45° change of direction in soil and waste systems. These spigot-to-socket solvent weld fittings have a long tail for insertion into another fitting and are supplied in a pack of two. Made from durable ABS, they are manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and are kitemarked. For solvent weld installation, clean pipe and fitting, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 12 hours before testing. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement. Solvent weld joints are permanent.

product.name: FloPlast 90 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend M&F, 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: Pack of two 40mm ABS swivel waste bends to create a compact 90° change of direction in domestic waste pipe systems. Commonly called M and F or spigot bends, each fitting has a long tail to insert into a socket for solvent-weld jointing. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked. For solvent welding, ensure pipe and fitting are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 5 minutes to set; leave 12 hours before testing. Solvent welds are permanent. Work in a well-ventilated area, keep cement away from heat and flames and avoid skin contact; wash with soap and water if contact occurs.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Waste Bend 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° solvent weld waste bends change direction in waste pipe runs and can be used in pairs to create offsets. Available in 32mm, 40mm and 50mm sizes, this listing is for the 40mm option supplied as a pack of two. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked, the ABS fittings use solvent weld jointing. To fit, ensure pipe and fitting are clean and free of grit, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact. Wipe away excess solvent, allow 5 minutes to set and leave the installation for 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid contact with skin; if contact occurs, wash thoroughly with soap and water.

product.name: FloPlast Solvent Weld Waste Reducer 40mm x 32mm White Pack of 2
product.description: Solvent weld waste reducer to join a 32mm waste pipe into a 40mm pipe, commonly used where the smaller pipe drops into the larger pipe—such as the branch of a 40mm tee or one end of a 40mm coupling. Made from durable ABS and supplied as a pack of two. To install, ensure pipe and fitting surfaces are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact, then wipe away excess cement and allow 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent; work in a well-ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement.
